provenance: Original 16-ply stems authored directly for chess0live from ordinary chess patterns before generating tails; no external game database, prior owner engine assets, engine search, evaluation, or outcome selection. Earlier chess0live suites are read only to exclude already exposed final roots.
limitations: Stems and their eight continuations are related. SHA-256 selection is deterministic pseudorandom selection, not proof of independent samples. Moves are sampled uniformly from sorted legal moves before the documented terminal/duplicate/overlap rejection. No material or evaluation filter is applied; balance, representativeness, and independent pair outcomes are unproven assumptions. Full histories retain all earlier repetition state.

policy.sharding: (stem_index % 2) * 4 + variant % 4 + 1; stem order, then ascending variants
policy.selection: Sorted legal UCI moves; SHA256 ASCII domain|seed|stem|variant|attempt|tail_ply|draw_counter; big-endian 256-bit word; reject >= floor(2**256/count)*count, then word % count
policy.counters: variant, attempt, tail_ply, draw_counter are zero-based
rejections: terminal anywhere in tail (outcome with claim_draw=True)

inherited_limitations: This catalog covers declared saved root corpora, not every internal search node or every position in historical match transcripts.
The second October 18 manual game has no saved PGN; its full position history is unavailable and cannot be exhaustively excluded.
Valid six-field FEN literals are extracted from correctness tests; dynamically constructed/random test states are represented only when saved by the listed evidence.
Local results/ artifacts and the private puzzle workbook are not required in a public checkout; their canonical root keys and source hashes are retained here.
